interpretation: This packet records first-party Ministry of Textiles, PIB and parliamentary source observations for reviewer use. It does not approve the authority, opportunity, eligibility rule, benefit, window or publication status.
sourcePolicy: The Ministry of Textiles programme route, PIB announcement and Rajya Sabha answer control the GREAT operational record; the Startup India Playbook is discovery-only cross-check evidence.

records.sourceAnchor: Pages 1-3: current approved-startup count, maximum support, monitoring, individual eligibility and startup-company eligibility
observations: The Ministry of Textiles' 13 February 2026 answer describes GREAT as a National Technical Textiles Mission route supporting young innovators, scientists/technologists and startup ventures in translating technical-textiles ideas into commercial technologies/products.
The answer states maximum support of INR 50 lakh for each approved startup, reports 24 approved startup projects and identifies a Review and Monitoring Committee.

The extracted individual criteria include Indian citizenship, minimum age 21, incubator association, a registered company/startup before grant release and a restriction on individual applications by promoters/shareholders of technical-textiles startups.

The extracted startup criteria include private limited company, registered partnership or LLP form, turnover below INR 100 crore in any previous financial year, incorporation age no greater than five years, at least 51% resident-Indian ownership/control and functional R&D facility or incubator association.

The PIB announcement states the grant period is up to 18 months, gives an additional 10% of total grant-in-aid to incubators and mandates minimum 10% funding investment from the incubatee in two equal installments.
